day_shape: 78 items: dueling Strait of Hormuz narratives with CENTCOM rebutting IRGC claims and Iran's navy reporting a tanker fire, Jerusalem Post citing warnings Iran told Hezbollah to prepare for war, reported US MOAB strike plans against Iran, and heavy Khamenei/IRIB messaging; nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz claims and counter-claims
threads.summary: Iranian state media and Defa Press amplified Army chief Hatami's claim the Strait of Hormuz is under complete surveillance and that Iran can halt ship-to-ship oil transfers, alongside a reported tanker fire in the Sea of Oman. CENTCOM called three recent IRGC claims — including control of the strait and a Singapore-flagged ship striking a mine — false, saying commercial transit continues.

threads.label: Iran-Hezbollah readiness and US strike reporting
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Iran instructed Hezbollah to raise readiness over an assessment that a new round of US strikes is "only a matter of time," and separately reported US strike plans against Iran including the GBU-43/B MOAB. The Post also cited sources saying Netanyahu fears an Iran campaign in the two weeks before the election could hurt Likud.

threads.label: Hezbollah explosives seizure in Lebanon
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Hezbollah acknowledged ownership of an explosives-laden vehicle and more than 500kg of explosives seized by Lebanese security forces. The posts questioned why Hezbollah would publicly claim the cache.

threads.label: IDF operations in Gaza and West Bank
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed two Palestinian weapons smugglers, Basel Nabil Abd al-Rahman Kashta and Ahmad Raja al-Shaer, in a Khan Younis strike, apprehended a Jenin weapons trader, and demolished a 1.5km Hamas tunnel crossing the Yellow Line. IRIB described the Gaza strikes as a "savage attack" on Al-Jalaa Street.

threads.label: CICA Baku walkout over Herzog speech
threads.summary: Representatives from Iran, Turkey, Kuwait, Pakistan and the Palestinian Authority walked out of Israeli President Herzog's CICA speech in Baku, per Jerusalem Post. Khamenei adviser Velayati criticised Azerbaijan's "warm reception" of Herzog and questioned Baku's fitness to host a future OIC meeting.

threads.label: Iran internal security and dissent
threads.summary: Iran International reported the arrest of an armed suspect over an alleged plot to kill a former minister after a Khatami gathering, and a German court jailed two men for Quds Force spying on Jewish figures. Jerusalem Post reported a Basij female-unit commander killed in Mehrestan and reinforcements deployed to Balochistan; Defa Press announced seizure of 122 weapons in Sistan-Baluchestan.

threads.label: Khamenei messaging and regime domestic cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office and IRIB pushed a message warning against "demoralising statements" harming public motivation, while Defa Press and former Tehran mayor Karbaschi debated ending the war, with Karbaschi saying Iran "cannot bring America to its knees." IRIB also carried Majid Majidi's Busan Film Festival remarks and Nurses' Day/Lady Zainab commemorations.
